title: Namaz of Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s)
introduction:
NAMAZ OF IMAM MAHDI (A.T.F.S)

The established prayer of the Twelfth Holy Imam, al-Hujjah ibn al-Hasan (a.t.f.s.), traditionally offered in Masjid Jamkaran and during times of need.

verses.translation: This prayer consists of two units in each of which Surah al-Faatehah is recited once, but the following Ayah (verse) is repeated one hundred times:
You do we worship, and Yours aid we seek.

Then, Surah al-Tawheed is recited once.

After the namaz recite Tasbih of Hazrat Fatima Zahra (s.a.) and recite the dua of Imam Mahdi (a.t.f.s.):
